fields.body_md:
## At a glance

Simon Fraser University (SFU) is in British Columbia. This page uses its **Master of Science in Big Data** to show real costs and entry rules.

The most important fact is the fee. International tuition for 2026/27 is **CAD 13,856.16** a term. The four terms cost **CAD 55,424.64** (**₹36.18 lakh**).

| | Master of Science in Big Data |
|---|---|
| Length | 16 to 20 months full time |
| Co-op | Mandatory, paid |
| Intake | Fall 2027 |
| Tuition, four terms (2026/27) | **CAD 55,424.64** |
| Minimum GPA | **3.00** out of 4.33 |
| English test (IELTS) | **6.5** overall, **6.0** in each section |
| Apply by | **19 January 2027** |

SFU is a designated learning institution. IRCC's list shows it as a public institution. Its DLI number is O18781994282.

## What it really costs

The study permit asks you to show enough money for tuition, living costs and travel. Read the [proof of funds guide](/study-abroad/study-in/canada/canada-proof-of-funds-guide) for the rules.

Four terms of tuition cost **CAD 55,424.64** (**₹36.18 lakh**), at the 2026/27 rate. IRCC also asks for **CAD 23,448** for living costs (**₹15.30 lakh**) and your flights. SFU does not split the programme by year, so ask it for your first-year amount. Rents are in our [cost of living guide](/study-abroad/study-in/canada/canada-cost-of-living).

Rupee amounts use **₹65.27 per Canadian dollar**, the Bank of Canada rate for 27 November 2026. Rates move every day and your bank will charge its own rate, so treat the rupee figures as a guide.

## Getting in

SFU asks for a computer science or related bachelor's degree with a GPA of at least **3.00 out of 4.33**. It lists a separate academic rule for each country, and we could not read India's. See the [programme page](/study-abroad/program-detail/canada/simon-fraser-university/sfu-master-of-science-big-data) for the details.

## Deadlines

SFU is taking applications for Fall 2027. Apply by **19 January 2027**.

## Popular programs for Indian students

- [Master of Science in Big Data](/study-abroad/program-detail/canada/simon-fraser-university/sfu-master-of-science-big-data): 16 to 20 months, mandatory co-op, tuition CAD 55,424.64 for four terms.

## Who it suits

**A strong choice if** you hold a computer science degree and want a co-op placement inside the master's.

**Think carefully if** you cannot confirm SFU's rules for your Indian degree. Fees listed are for 2026/27.

## Sources

- [SFU Master of Science in Big Data](https://www.sfu.ca/fas/study/future-graduates/programs/master-big-data.html). Checked on 28 November 2026.
- [SFU graduate admission requirements](https://www.sfu.ca/gradstudies/apply/applying/requirements.html). Checked on 28 November 2026.
- [IRCC designated learning institutions list](https://www.canada.ca/en/immigration-refugees-citizenship/services/study-canada/study-permit/prepare/designated-learning-institutions-list.html). Checked on 28 November 2026.
- [IRCC proof of financial support](https://www.canada.ca/en/immigration-refugees-citizenship/services/study-canada/study-permit/get-documents/financial-support.html). Checked on 28 November 2026.
- [Bank of Canada exchange rates](https://www.bankofcanada.ca/rates/exchange/daily-exchange-rates/). Checked on 28 November 2026.

Fees and rules change. Always confirm on the university's own website before you pay or apply.

faq_json.q: How much does the SFU Master of Science in Big Data cost for international students?
faq_json.a: SFU lists CAD 13,856.16 per term for 2026/27. The four terms come to CAD 55,424.64, about ₹36.18 lakh at ₹65.27 per Canadian dollar. SFU has not published the Fall 2027 fee.

faq_json.q: What GPA do I need for the SFU Big Data master's?
faq_json.a: SFU asks for a bachelor's degree in computer science or a related field with a GPA of at least 3.00 out of 4.33, or 3.33 on the last 60 credits. For Indian degrees SFU lists its own rule by country.

faq_json.q: What is the SFU Big Data deadline for Fall 2027?
faq_json.a: 19 January 2027. SFU says applications are open for Fall 2027.

faq_json.q: What IELTS score does SFU need?
faq_json.a: SFU's university minimum is IELTS 6.5 overall with 6.0 in each section. The programme may ask for more. You may not need a test if your degree was taught in English in an accepted country.
